digest.component_or_area: AWS review-bot tickets clone and autodeploy
propositions: The EBS-backed persistent tickets clone is not refreshed on redeploy because the entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, leaving divergent history in place across redeployments.
The entrypoint invokes ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT block, so convergence must run even when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset, but the script currently does not fetch or reset divergent clones.
The deploy path omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS in autodeploy.sh, preventing script-only changes from triggering redeploy and self-convergence.
Convergence must remain best-effort and must never undo or wedge an already-cast Gerrit vote; store write failures after post_vote must be caught without affecting vote recording.

After fetch with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets, compatible equal/behind/ahead/same-epoch-divergent histories must use existing reconverge to preserve local-only commits; pre-epoch local tips with readable prior remote tips that are ancestors must adopt the fetched epoch-bearing remote commit.

Failed or credentialless fetches must exit success, preserve the local tip exactly, emit operator-readable warnings, and require manual intervention for unreadable prior remote, corrupt epoch, or local-ahead/diverged states.
